label: D2 after a lose-switch to a1
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when this trial chose a1 (in_action == 1; 100% of activations), mostly when reaching S1 (89% of mass) and after an unrewarded previous trial (91% of mass). Strongest and most precise on a lose-switch to a1: D2 after switching from a2 to a1 following no reward (dev P 0.71, R 0.42, F1 0.53, mass recall 0.58; coverage rises from 17% of the lowest activation quartile to 69% of the top quartile, so these cases are the largest). The rest of the mass is a1 D2 steps after unrewarded trials with no clear switch, e.g. repeated unrewarded a1 trials or the window first trial where stay is unknown; the broader (phase == D2) & (action == 1) & (prev_reward == 0) catches 91% of mass but at precision 0.15. Never fires at D1 or GO, after a2 choices, or after rewarded trials (rare). Much more frequent early in the episode (trials 0-9 3.7x lift, nearly silent after trial 80) and soon after reversals, which fits a role in uncertain/exploratory a1 choices. All variables are observed at D2.
